description: Run language models locally on a llama.cpp server that exposes an OpenAI-compatible API on 127.0.0.1:8081, with the backend picked from your GPU (CUDA, ROCm or Vulkan) and optional VRAM/RAM layer overflow. Models are declared as GGUF presets pulled from HuggingFace; Open WebUI (port 8080) and the Newelle desktop client come as front-ends.
